title: classical-equality
description: The classical two-valued equality predicate =_E on a predication hyperdoctrine, derived (not postulated) as the truth-order Lawvere image of the constant-t valuation on the diagonal of an entity set.

hyperdoctrine.description: the predication hyperdoctrine on whose truth-order adjoint system the equality is derived

entity-set.description: the entity set E whose diagonal sub-support Delta_E = {(s,s) : s in E} carries the equality

definition.description: the truth-order Lawvere image of the leq_t-terminal (constant-t valuation) on Delta_E along the predicate specialization g : q -> p

two-valued.description: =_E(s, o) = t when s = o and f when s != o

derived.description: obtained from the dual adjoint triple via Lawvere's diagonal-Sigma construction rather than postulated as a primitive
